lines.text: In the second year of Darius, Haggai asks the priests whether consecrated meat in a garment makes touched food holy.
The priests say food touched by someone defiled by a corpse becomes defiled, so it is with this people.
Before one stone was placed on another in the temple, someone expecting twenty ephahs of grain found only fifteen.
The LORD struck the work of their hands with blight, mildew, and locusts, but they did not turn to Him.
On the day the temple's foundation was laid, the LORD says that from this day on He will bless them.
